source: FDIC BankFind Suite, financial summary: national annual totals
license: US Government work, public domain (FDIC BankFind Suite API)
derived_by: prometheus.data_ingestion.fdic_banks (national rows, commercial banks and savings institutions added)

columns.banks: number of FDIC-insured institutions at year end
columns.loans: total loans and leases, USD thousands (gross of the allowance)
columns.equity_securities: equity securities not held for trading, USD thousands; blank where the FDIC reports none (it reports none from 2022)
columns.cash_and_balances: cash and balances due from banks, USD thousands
columns.equity: total equity capital, USD thousands; reported from 1984
columns.net_charge_offs: net loan and lease charge-offs during the year, USD thousands
columns.net_income: net income during the year, USD thousands
columns.interest_income: total interest income during the year, USD thousands
columns.interest_expense: total interest expense during the year, USD thousands
columns.net_interest_income: net interest income during the year, USD thousands
columns.noncurrent_loans: noncurrent loans and leases at year end, USD thousands

frequency: annual; the date is the year end
caveat: includes savings institutions; field definitions changed over the decades, so statistics are used from the first year equity is reported
